newsitem.title: CHINA: China plastic products prices rise in Q1.
newsitem.headline: China plastic products prices rise in Q1.

text.p: Prices of plastic products in China rebounded in the first quarter of this year and were expected to rise further, the Market Daily said on Wednesday.
The newspaper attributed the surge to greater domestic demand and soaring prices of raw materials. It did not elaborate.

In Jinan city in eastern Shandong province, prices of some plastic products jumped to the current 9,100 yuan ($1,096) per tonne from 8,780 yuan in early 1997 and were on an upward trend, the newspaper said.
In Ningbo city in eastern Zhejiang province, prices of polyvinyl chloride were around 7,200 yuan per tonne by the end of March, an increase of 150 yuan, it said without giving further details.
